import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 50;
    static final int MAXM = 50;
    static final int MAXK = 50;
    static final int T_val = MAXN + MAXK + 1;
    static final int NN = MAXN * T_val + 1;
    static final int MM = MAXK + (MAXM * 2 * MAXK + MAXN) * (T_val - 1);
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static class AdjNode {
        AdjNode next;
        int node;
    }

    static AdjNode[] aa = new AdjNode[MAXN];
    static AdjNode[] aa_ = new AdjNode[NN];
    static AdjNode[] pool1 = new AdjNode[1];
    static AdjNode[] pool2 = new AdjNode[1];

    static int[] pi = new int[NN];
    static int[] kk = new int[NN];
    static int[] bb = new int[NN];
    static int[] pq = new int[NN + 1];
    static int[] iq = new int[NN];
    static int pq_size;

    static boolean lt(int u, int v) {
        return pi[u] < pi[v] || (pi[u] == pi[v] && kk[u] < kk[v]);
    }

    static int get_child(int i) {
        i *= 2;
        if (i > pq_size) return 0;
        if (i < pq_size && lt(pq[i+1], pq[i])) return i+1;
        return i;
    }

    static void heap_up(int u) {
        int i = iq[u];
        int j;
        while ((j = i / 2) != 0 && lt(u, pq[j])) {
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
            i = j;
        }
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    static void heap_down(int u) {
        int i = iq[u];
        int j;
        while ((j = get_child(i)) != 0 && lt(pq[j], u)) {
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
            i = j;
        }
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    static void heap_insert(int u) {
        iq[u] = ++pq_size;
        heap_up(u);
    }

    static int heap_extract() {
        int u = pq[1];
        int v = pq[pq_size--];
        iq[v] = 1;
        heap_down(v);
        return u;
    }

    static void add_edge(int i, int j) {
        if (pool1[0] == null) {
            pool1[0] = new AdjNode[MAXN * MAXM * 2 + 1];
            pool1[0]--;
        }
        pool1[0].node = j;
        pool1[0].next = aa[i].next;
        aa[i].next = pool1[0]++;
    }

    static void add_edge_graph2(int i, int h) {
        if (pool2[0] == null) {
            pool2[0] = new AdjNode[MM * 2 + 1];
            pool2[0]--;
        }
        pool2[0].node = h;
        pool2[0].next = aa_[i].next;
        aa_[i].next = pool2[0]++;
    }

    static int n_nodes, m_edges;
    static int[] U = new int[MM];
    static int[] V = new int[MM];
    static int[] UV = new int[MM];
    static int[] COST = new int[MM];
    static int[] COST_red = new int[MM];
    static int[] CAP = new int[MM * 2];

    static void add_link(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = m_edges++;
        U[h] = u; V[h] = v; UV[h] = u ^ v;
        COST[h] = cos;
        CAP[h << 1 ^ 0] = cap;
        add_edge_graph2(u, h << 1 ^ 0);
        add_edge_graph2(v, h << 1 ^ 1);
    }

    static void dijkstra_spf(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(pi, 0, n_nodes, INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        heap_insert(s);
        while (pq_size > 0) {
            AdjNode curr;
            int u = heap_extract();
            int v;
            int h, h_, dist, dist2 = kk[u] + 1;

            for (curr = aa_[u].next; curr != null; curr = curr.next) {
                if (CAP[h_ = curr.node] > 0) {
                    h = h_ >> 1;
                    dist = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? COST_red[h] : -COST_red[h]);
                    v = u ^ UV[h];
                    if (pi[v] == INF) {
                        pi[v] = dist;
                        kk[v] = dist2;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        heap_insert(v);
                    } else if (pi[v] > dist || (pi[v] == dist && kk[v] > dist2)) {
                        pi[v] = dist;
                        kk[v] = dist2;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        heap_up(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void augment_path(int s, int t) {
        int u, h, h_;
        for (u = t; u != s; u ^= UV[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            CAP[h_]--;
            CAP[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    static int min_cost_flow(int source, int sink) {
        int total_cost, idx;
        System.arraycopy(COST, 0, COST_red, 0, m_edges);
        while (true) {
            dijkstra_spf(source);
            if (pi[sink] == INF) break;
            augment_path(source, sink);
            for (idx = 0; idx < m_edges; idx++) {
                int u = U[idx], v = V[idx];
                if (pi[u] != INF && pi[v] != INF)
                    COST_red[idx] += pi[u] - pi[v];
            }
        }
        total_cost = 0;
        for (idx = 0; idx < m_edges; idx++)
            total_cost += COST[idx] * CAP[idx << 1 ^ 1];
        return total_cost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        // Initialize arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) aa[i] = new AdjNode();
        for (int i = 0; i < NN; i++) aa_[i] = new AdjNode();
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        
        int[] initials = new int[MAXK];
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            initials[h] = sc.nextInt();
            initials[h]--;
        }
        
        while (m-- > 0) {
            int i = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            add_edge(i, j);
            add_edge(j, i);
        }
        
        int t = n + k + 1;
        n_nodes = n * t + 1;
        m_edges = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                AdjNode curr;
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (curr = aa[i].next; curr != null; curr = curr.next) {
                    int j = curr.node;
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++)
                        add_link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                int v = u + 1;
                add_link(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++)
            add_link(n_nodes - 1, initials[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);
            
        System.out.println(min_cost_flow(n_nodes - 1, 0 * t + t - 1));
    }
}
